historicalExactPreviewQualification.rule: Do not promote the historical runtime HOLD wholesale to the current candidate. Rebind only mechanisms still physically present in current source.

currentSourceFindings.mechanism: Current runtime config requests optional collections including cancelaciones and auditoria, while the current protected store whitelist and scoped related reader do not support them.
currentSourceFindings.effect: _ensureCollections records attach errors for unsupported optional collections. Any module that requires those collections cannot reach authoritative protected readiness.

currentSourceFindings.mechanism: Role change clears protected caches and immediately reattaches every previously started collection, including optional/failed collections, instead of route-priority hydration.
currentSourceFindings.effect: Repeated protected reads and repeated attach errors after Dirección→Operativo→Asesor→Dirección can delay or destabilize route readiness.

currentSourceFindings.mechanism: Selected role is persisted and orbit:session is emitted before orbit:active-role-changed invalidates protected store context.
currentSourceFindings.effect: Router/session rerender can observe stale or empty prior-role state before authoritative new-role hydration settles.

currentSourceFindings.mechanism: Product app schedules all optional collections immediately after bootstrap and prewarms financial route collections; Inicio also ensures five core/financial collections on first render.
currentSourceFindings.effect: This defeats the intended minimal route-primary hydration and competes with first useful render.
